sgce_raw_pair_persistence_diagnostic.interpretation: No detected persistence edge in raw historical pair co-occurrence; this does not test unspecified spectral hyperparameters.

adaptive_k_exact_null_exposure.interpretation: Raw recall improvement from K expansion has a large exact-null exposure component and cannot be credited as predictive lift.

macro_sum_volatility_diagnostics.interpretation: Exploratory only; no detected basis for macro-sum-volatility-controlled K expansion at the present sample.

gap_null_filtering.reason: NULL_GAP_DM is uniform over all legal six-gap compositions and therefore cannot rank or reject one legal line as less structurally null-probable than another.

in_wheel_pruning.reason: Moving an unchanged filter earlier can reduce compute but does not create predictive information. Gemini supplied no reproducible polarity or elastic-sum filter formula.
